provisional_weaknesses: can produce unsupported formal claims when used as sole prover
higher risk of overclaiming closure without external audit
not suitable as sole authority on deep proof

THEORETICAL_MATHEMATICIAN.mission: build global proof structures, invariants, necessary/sufficient conditions and arbitrary-N arguments

NUMBER_THEORIST.mission: congruences, valuations, Diophantine constraints, factor/order and modular arguments

DYNAMICAL_SYSTEMS_SPECIALIST.mission: orbits, first-return maps, recurrence, excursions and nonrecyclable quantities

COMBINATORICS_SPECIALIST.mission: valuation words, packing, entropy, automata and prefix structures

ERGODIC_SPECTRAL_SPECIALIST.mission: transfer operators, renewal, spectral radius and measure/count separation

P_ADIC_SPECIALIST.mission: 2-adic reconstruction, residue cylinders, exact valuation classes and CRT compatibility

ARCHIMEDEAN_ANALYST.mission: real interval geometry, dyadic bands, normalized height and analytic inequalities

DIOPHANTINE_SPECIALIST.mission: logarithmic forms, approximation, gap inequalities and minimum-cycle bounds

FORMAL_PROOF_AUDITOR.mission: quantifiers, hidden assumptions, circularity, exact domains and arbitrary-N validity

COUNTEREXAMPLE_HUNTER.mission: pseudo-orbits, critical families, countermodels and adversarial regimes

COMPUTATIONAL_EXPERIMENTER.mission: finite experiments to generate/falsify conjectures, never as proof

PROOF_SYNTHESIST.mission: merge surviving lemmas into the shortest rigorous chain and expose the residual

POLYMORPHIC_MATHEMATICIAN.mission: switch specialty according to the active bottleneck while preserving evidence rules
POLYMORPHIC_MATHEMATICIAN.routing_rule: choose specialist persona from active lock; do not keep a fixed persona when residual changes

team_composition.independence_rule: VERIFIER or AUDITOR of a critical claim must be from an independent model family whenever available
team_composition.subject_rule: specialist identities are selected from the active mathematical lock
team_composition.recomposition_rule: rebuild the team when the residual changes, while preserving checkpoint and accepted lemmas
team_composition.scaling_rule: when additional independent AI workers become available, create new specialist roles first; duplicate existing roles only after coverage of useful specialties

capacity_examples.18_external_plus_assistant: 19 active researchers, minimum 20 distinct functions; at least one participant carries multiple functions
capacity_examples.20_external_plus_assistant: 21 active researchers; retain at least 20 roles and add one or more specialist roles if useful
capacity_examples.more_than_20_external: expand specialties, independent replication lanes, theorem-specific auditors and alternative-route teams

assistant_role.title: ACTIVE_RESEARCH_COORDINATOR_AND_CO_PROVER
must: redistribute roles when team strengths or active lock change
fill uncovered critical role when external capacity is insufficient
must_not: treat agent output as evidence without audit
delegate final mathematical responsibility to external agents

required_for_acceptance: assistant independent derivation and formal verification

after_each_wave: allow polymorphic reassignment when bottleneck changes
expand role diversity when additional independent workers become available
